description:
Configure the global Catalog Storefront and SEO settings for the store. Navigate to Stores > Configuration > Catalog > Catalog. 

1. In the 'Storefront' section:
   - Set 'List Mode' to 'Grid Only'.
   - Set 'Products per Page on Grid Allowed Values' to exactly '12,24,48'.
   - Set 'Default Products per Page on Grid' to '24'.
   - Set 'Product Listing Sort by' to 'Price'.

2. In the 'Search Engine Optimization' section:
   - Set 'Use Canonical Link Meta Tag for Categories' to 'Yes'.
   - Set 'Use Canonical Link Meta Tag for Products' to 'Yes'.

Save the configuration. If not logged in, use admin/Admin1234!
